_about: Public-domain Emanuel Swedenborg (1688-1772), the Swedish scientist turned visionary theologian, in nineteenth-century English translations for the Word Hoard: Heaven and Hell (Noble's translation, 1872, and the London edition of 1843), the True Christian Religion (Boston, 1833), Divine Love and Wisdom (1883), Divine Providence (1840 and 1851), the ten-volume Arcana Caelestia (New York, 1882), the Apocalypse Revealed (1832) and Conjugial Love (1871), from Internet Archive scans. These are the New Church's own editions; most title pages name no translator, and that is recorded per book. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
